usage: policy for approved SAST being disabled
name: Repos should not be public
description: Code Repository should not be publically visible or modifiable.
detailedDescription: Code repositories for open source projects are typically public and proprietary apps should typically be private. If proprietary code is exposed to the internet, attackers can utilize it to understand weaknesses and vulnerabilities in the application, allowing for easier hacks and breaches.

args.name: publicreponumber
args.label: Exclusion Threshold %
args.tooltip: If there are more than the defined percentage of apps public then we assume this is intentional and will not throw a violation on public apps.

args.name: checkLicense
args.label: Ignore if license present
args.tooltip: If set to true and a public repo has a license file no issue will be generated

args.name: licenseFileNames
args.label: License File Names
args.tooltip: License File names to search for
